source.title: Practical reasoning as presumptive argumentation using action based alternating transition systems

record.scoped_approval: legacy flat AS1 premises/conclusion and explicitly inherited policies; successful focused regression behavior

question_coverage.qualification: Dedicated predicates are not required if a documented and tested valid-model/premise-challenge contract discharges CQ12,14,15; that contract is not presently established.

questions.decision: p. 858; AS1 circumstances. AS2 also makes the acting agent's action preconditions explicit (pp. 861-862).
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: For AS2, represent the actual initial state and action preconditions.

questions.question_paraphrase: Does the action have the alleged consequences in these circumstances?
questions.decision: pp. 858, 862; the asserted transition. This does not separately model the other agents' choices in CQ17.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: For AS2, identify the full joint-action transition; keep CQ17 separate.

questions.question_paraphrase: Do those consequences realize the desired goal?
questions.decision: pp. 858, 862; goal in the resulting state. AS2 additionally represents whether the proposition changes between states.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: For AS2, represent the relevant proposition change between initial and resulting states.

questions.question_paraphrase: Does the goal promote the stated value?
questions.decision: pp. 858, 861-862; AS1 abstraction. AS2 values are agent-specific and transition-relative; this inherited relation omits those arguments.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: For AS2, scope valuation by deciding agent and transition.

questions.question_paraphrase: Is there another action achieving the same consequences?
questions.decision: pp. 858-859, 862; another action achieving the same consequences. bring_about_more_effectively(S2,A) is a stronger application policy, not a complete mapping.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Represent an alternative witness and a justified comparison; greater effectiveness is only the inherited stronger policy.

questions.question_paraphrase: Is there another action achieving the same goal?
questions.decision: pp. 858-859, 862; another action achieving the same goal. realize_more_effectively(G,A) is a stronger application policy, not a complete mapping.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Represent an alternative witness and comparison without presuming that existence alone defeats the original action.

questions.question_paraphrase: Is there another action promoting the same value?
questions.decision: pp. 858-859, 862; another action promoting the same value. promote_more_effectively(V,A) is a stronger application policy, not a complete mapping.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Represent an alternative witness with the same promoted value and an explicit comparison.

questions.question_paraphrase: Does a side effect demote the same value?
questions.decision: pp. 858-859, 862; legacy approximation only: merges same-value and other-value demotion and undercuts unconditionally, without a negative AS1 argument or value comparison.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Distinguish same-value demotion, generate the negative argument and define its comparison with positive reasons.

questions.question_paraphrase: Does a side effect demote a different value?
questions.decision: pp. 858-859, 862, 868; legacy approximation only. The paper allows a contrary preference to defeat a negative side-effect argument; this aggregate exception does not.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Retain the demoted value and an explicit preference/argument comparison; no automatic global priority for any side effect.

questions.question_paraphrase: Does the action also promote another value?
questions.decision: p. 862 explicitly treats this as positive support, not a reason against performing A. Another goal/value instantiation can support the same conclusion; the farmer's Arg6 (p. 866) promotes P and F. This is the AS1 abstraction, not full agent/transition modelling.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Preserve distinct additional positive justifications; full AS2 additionally needs agent/transition scope.

questions.question_paraphrase: Does this action preclude an action promoting a different value?
questions.decision: pp. 858-859, 862, 865; the action precludes another action promoting a different value. No explicit incompatibility relation, alternative witness or value comparison in this record.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Represent the incompatible alternative, its distinct promoted value and comparison.

questions.question_paraphrase: Are the described initial circumstances possible?
questions.decision: pp. 858, 862; whether the described initial circumstances are possible. No corresponding default or AATS state-membership check; proposed burden is an executable interpretation, not stated by the paper.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Choose and test an explicit valid-model contract or a separate state-possibility challenge; no claim that the paper prescribes default burden.

questions.decision: pp. 858, 862; action feasibility. The default/questioning burden is Carneades' policy; the paper formalizes joint-action membership.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: For AS2, validate joint-action membership; legacy default burden is implementation policy.

questions.decision: pp. 858, 862; whether the described consequences are possible. No corresponding default or AATS successor-state membership check; proposed burden is an executable interpretation.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Choose and test a valid-model contract or a separate successor-state possibility challenge.

questions.decision: pp. 858, 862; whether the goal is realizable in any state. worthy_goal(G) is a different claim. No realizability mapping; proposed burden is an executable interpretation.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Choose and test realizability or a valid-model construction contract; worthiness is not realizability.

questions.decision: pp. 858, 862, 865; value membership/legitimacy. The default/questioning burden is Carneades' policy.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: For AS2, distinguish model value membership and agent valuation; retain explicit default/questioning policy.

questions.question_paraphrase: Will the other agents execute their required parts of the joint action?
questions.decision: p. 859 introduces the additional CQ; p. 862 distinguishes the other agents' joint-action choices from CQ2. No agent/joint-action/cooperation mapping; proposed burden is an executable interpretation.
questions.required_for_full_source_coverage: Represent other agents and their component choices; distinguish failure to choose a transition from a nonexistent transition.
